Agent.CreatedExactlyWhenVersioned.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[
					s.status === "",
					s.version === 0,
					s.current_version_id === "",
					s.name === "",
					s.model_id === "",
					!s.has_system,
					s.system === "",
					!s.has_description,
					s.description === "",
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					s.status !== "",
					s.version >= 1,
					s.current_version_id !== "",
					s.name !== "",
					s.model_id !== "",
					[s.has_system, s.system === ""].some((ok) => ok),
					[s.has_description, s.description === ""].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Agent.ArchivedAgentStaysArchived.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "archived",
				[
					after.status === "archived",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.current_version_id === before.current_version_id,
					after.name === before.name,
					after.model_id === before.model_id,
					after.has_system === before.has_system,
					after.system === before.system,
					after.has_description === before.has_description,
					after.description === before.description,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Agent.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				[
					after.status !== "",
					[
						after.version === before.version,
						[
							before.status === "active",
							after.status === "active",
							after.version === before.version + 1,
						].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

CreateAgent.NewAgentStartsAtVersionOne.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				before.agent.status === "",
				after.agent.status === "active",
				after.agent.version === 1,
				after.agent.current_version_id === command.version_id,
			].every((ok) => ok)

UpdateAgent.ChangeMintsNextVersionOrNoOp.source:
({ before, after, command }) => {
			const name = command.changes.name === undefined ? before.agent.name : command.changes.name
			const modelId =
				command.changes.model === undefined ? before.agent.model_id : command.changes.model.id
			const hasSystem =
				command.changes.system === undefined
					? before.agent.has_system
					: command.changes.system !== null
			const system =
				command.changes.system === undefined ? before.agent.system : (command.changes.system ?? "")
			const hasDescription =
				command.changes.description === undefined
					? before.agent.has_description
					: command.changes.description !== null
			const description =
				command.changes.description === undefined
					? before.agent.description
					: (command.changes.description ?? "")
			const mcpServers =
				command.changes.mcp_servers === undefined
					? before.agent.mcp_servers
					: command.changes.mcp_servers
			const tools = command.changes.tools === undefined ? before.agent.tools : command.changes.tools
			const unchanged = [
				name === before.agent.name,
				modelId === before.agent.model_id,
				hasSystem === before.agent.has_system,
				system === before.agent.system,
				hasDescription === before.agent.has_description,
				description === before.agent.description,
				mcpServers === before.agent.mcp_servers,
				tools === before.agent.tools,
			].every((same) => same)
			return [
				before.agent.status === "active",
				after.agent.status === "active",
				[
					[
						unchanged,
						after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
						after.agent.current_version_id === before.agent.current_version_id,
					].every((ok) => ok),
					[
						!unchanged,
						after.agent.version === before.agent.version + 1,
						after.agent.current_version_id === command.next_version_id,
						after.agent.name === name,
						after.agent.model_id === modelId,
						after.agent.has_system === hasSystem,
						after.agent.system === system,
						after.agent.has_description === hasDescription,
						after.agent.description === description,
						after.agent.mcp_servers === mcpServers,
						after.agent.tools === tools,
					].every((ok) => ok),
				].some((ok) => ok),
			].every((ok) => ok)
		}

UpdateAgent.UnchangedConfigMintsNothing.source:
({ before, after, command }) => {
			const name = command.changes.name === undefined ? before.agent.name : command.changes.name
			const modelId =
				command.changes.model === undefined ? before.agent.model_id : command.changes.model.id
			const hasSystem =
				command.changes.system === undefined
					? before.agent.has_system
					: command.changes.system !== null
			const system =
				command.changes.system === undefined ? before.agent.system : (command.changes.system ?? "")
			const hasDescription =
				command.changes.description === undefined
					? before.agent.has_description
					: command.changes.description !== null
			const description =
				command.changes.description === undefined
					? before.agent.description
					: (command.changes.description ?? "")
			const mcpServers =
				command.changes.mcp_servers === undefined
					? before.agent.mcp_servers
					: command.changes.mcp_servers
			const tools = command.changes.tools === undefined ? before.agent.tools : command.changes.tools
			return [
				before.agent.status !== "active",
				name !== before.agent.name,
				modelId !== before.agent.model_id,
				hasSystem !== before.agent.has_system,
				system !== before.agent.system,
				hasDescription !== before.agent.has_description,
				description !== before.agent.description,
				mcpServers !== before.agent.mcp_servers,
				tools !== before.agent.tools,
				[
					after.agent.status === "active",
					after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
					after.agent.current_version_id === before.agent.current_version_id,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)
		}

Agents.EveryRecordedVersionBelongsToItsA.source:
(m) =>
			m.AgentVersionByNumberView.every((v) =>
				m.Agent.some((a) => {
					const source = a.events
						.filter((event) => event._tag === "agent.created" || event._tag === "agent.updated")
						.find((event) => event.version === v.state.version)
					if (source === undefined) {
						return false
					}
					return [
						a.id === v.state.agent_id,
						a.state.status !== "",
						v.state.version <= a.state.version,
						v.id === `${a.id}@${v.state.version}`,
						source.version_id === v.state.id,
						source.name === v.state.name,
						source.model.id === v.state.model.id,
						source.system === v.state.system,
						source.description === v.state.description,
					].every((ok) => ok)
				}),
			)

CreateAgent.NewAgentKeepsItsDeclaredServ.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before.agent.status !== "" || after.agent.mcp_servers === command.mcp_servers

CreateAgent.NewAgentKeepsItsDeclaredTool.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before.agent.status !== "" || after.agent.tools === command.tools

					after.description === before.description,
					after.mcp_servers === before.mcp_servers,
					after.tools === before.tools,
				].every((ok) => ok),

UpdateAgent.AnExpectedVersionIsTheHeadVe.source:
({ before, command }) =>
			[
				command.expected_version === undefined,
				before.agent.version === command.expected_version,
			].some((ok) => ok)
